summary: Inbox uses c to add a note to the highlighted answer option. Notes remain attached to their options when the highlight changes; only the chosen option's note is sent. Free custom answers have a distinct entry when permitted. Keyboard and mouse follow the same answer behavior, and refused answers retain their note and an inline error.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing named-answer id and text fields; no wire-protocol changes.

downtime.detail: No expected interruption or additional startup work.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or re-pairing required.

recovery.detail: A refused Inbox answer restores its option binding and note in the running TUI. The error remains inline on the restored request until the person acts, rather than disappearing with a transient flash. Drafts are not persisted across TUI restarts.
